cd /Users/guillaumeloulier/PhpstormProjects/oss/elephc/.claude/worktrees/streams-csv-signature; python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('src/builtins/io/stat_support.rs')
t = p.read_text()
OLD = '''        PhpType::Bool,
    ])'''
NEW = '''        // php's signature is `array|false`, and the difference is not cosmetic: the union-unwrap
        // family that lets `array_keys(stat($p))` compile asks for exactly ONE array member beside
        // `false`, and a `bool` member could hold `true`, which is not a thing `stat()` returns.
        PhpType::False,
    ])'''
assert t.count(OLD) == 1
p.write_text(t.replace(OLD, NEW, 1))
print('stat() answers array|false, as php declares it')
